line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: Renegades.Plot.GetRandomShip.xml
* DESCRIPTION: Returns a random ship depending on the game's difficulty and whether a spawned ship is a Renegade roamer or defender.
* Each ship category contains 2 elite ships, 4-5 better ships, and 4-7 standard-grade ships. (Add-Ons 1.7.4: TMs are an exception: 2 elites, 2 better, 2 standard)
* AUTHOR: DATE: 14 November 2025
* Add-Ons 2.0: Replaced Helios Hauler with Chokaro Advanced. Zephyrus Adv effectively demoted from elite status.
* Defenders are renegade ships assigned to the renegade station. Roamers are renegade ships spawned throughout the galaxy.
* Add-Ons 1.2: Normal and hard difficulty increased - 10% chance to spawn an M6 and 5% chance to spawn an M7 respectively.

* Add-Ons 1.6.1: Raiders and assassins now spawn tougher ships (same as defenders) and have increased difficulty (+1 tier) if the player's fleet power is high enough. Exceeding the supply cap will also increase ship difficulty.
* Add-Ons 1.7.4: TMs can now spawn. However, they spawn 25% of the time compared to an M6.
* Do not spawn capital ships if there's already 2 spawned this cycle by the Renegade station. If called by Renegades.Monitor, this count is always 0.
* 10% chance to spawn an M6/TM for raider and defenders.
* 30% chance for normal difficulty. Can also happen on easy difficulty if raiders scaled up.
* 5% chance to spawn an M7 on hard difficulty. Can also happen on easy/normal difficulty if raiders/assassins scaled up 2/1 times respectively.
* On insane, the difficulty can scale up to level 5 (level 3 is regular insane). If difficulty is scaled up, then the chance to spawn an M7 is greatly increased.
* 10% chance to spawn an M7 for raider and defenders. This is the usual chance on insane. Can also happen on normal/hard difficulty if raiders scaled up.
* 20% chance to spawn an M7. Can happen on hard/insane if raiders/assassins scaled up 2/1 times respectively.
* 50% chance to spawn an M7. Only on insane mode and only if raiders/assassins scaled up twice.
* For renegades created by the renegade station, it's important to homebase this new renegade at the renegade station, so we have a means to track how many have been created.
* As we start to send out invasion swarms, some of these ships can be removed from the station ownership and sent to seek out a player sector.
* when that happens, the station task here will just build more to replace them.
* Does not color NPC ships.
* = [THIS]-> call script 'Lib.Gen.ColourShipName' : String=$name Colour=1 OnlySearchLastThreeForDigits=[FALSE] OnlyReturnString=[FALSE] Ship=$ship
* Only TMs and capital ships have hangars. (1.6.1: Check if it has docking bays instead of checking ship class.)
* On hard difficulty, there is a 10% chance for the ship to have pandora tuning.
* On insane, 40% chance for the ship to have pandora tuning.
* Add-Ons 1.4.10: Preserve pandora tuning. (1.6.1: This applies even if raiders are scaled up!)
* On insane, scaled raiders and assassins can get 1 additional pandora tuning, for a total of 2 pandora tunings!
* 20% chance for a 2nd pandora tuning.
* Note that insane mode is level 3 difficulty. Level 4 and 5 are possible only when renegades scale up.
* Defenders scale up by 1 tier at most, but raiders and assassins can scale by up to 2 tiers.
* Depends on how much scaling insane has.
* Insane+: 20% chance.
* Insane++: 40% chance.
* Add-Ons 1.7.4: Rather than choosing only M6s, there is now a 25% chance to spawn a TM instead.
